verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for an open-source, end-to-end encrypted 2FA app with sync, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions an official SDK or client library for Ente Auth. The CLI, the documented encrypted-export JSON format, deep links and llms.txt are adjacent tools or building blocks, not SDKs, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
